Overview

Sekondi-Takoradi is a city in Western with a population of 450,000. Ghana’s third-largest city and major seaport, the center of the country’s oil and gas industry. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 270 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 22.0.
